# Skills Policy

Use skills only when they match recurring tasks in this repository.

## Active Skills

- `adventure-ots-stack` — dedicated system-level guidance for TFS + backend + frontend + nginx + MariaDB + Docker Compose.
- `chrome-devtools` — frontend, browser, and proxy behavior validation.
- `python-pip-packaging` — Python dependency and packaging workflows.
- `docker-compose-ops` — local environment reliability and service orchestration.
- `api-testing-regression` — smoke/regression checks with reproducible evidence.
- `nginx-edge-debugging` — proxy/routing/header/timeout troubleshooting.

## Optional Skills

- none by default. Add only when a domain becomes recurring in this repository.

## Rule of Thumb

Prefer **3–6 high-usage skills** over many low-usage skills.
Remove stale skills to reduce routing noise.

## Deprecated / Removed Skills

- `game-engine` — removed because it is not aligned with the Adventure OTS runtime stack.
